_meta.description: OralBiome Pro review templates — source pool for the daily QStash cron /api/cron/ob-reviews-add. Each entry omits the id/d fields; the cron assigns those at insert time (id = 121+, d = today in Amsterdam TZ). Reviews are written in the native language of each country of origin per CALQIX brand guardrails. Expand freely — the cron samples uniformly at random from this pool.
